svg.title: Kiro Crew — under the hood
svg.text: One local gateway process multiplexes every surface onto kiro-cli agent sessions over ACP, adding memory, scheduling, orchestration and an un-disableable tool gate. Source: kirodotdev/KiroCrew docs/architecture/overview.md

g.data-label: Kiro Crew gateway — one asyncio process (Python, aiohttp)
g.text: Kiro Crew gateway — one asyncio process (Python, aiohttp)

g.data-label: ACP harness — kiro-cli acp (KAS v3 engine)
g.text: ACP harness — kiro-cli acp (KAS v3 engine)

g.data-tip: A person writes in the dashboard, a channel thread, or the CLI.

g.title: 1. A person writes in the dashboard, a channel thread, or the CLI.

g.data-tip: Every surface reaches the same gateway; channel senders must pass the owner lock first.

g.title: 2. Every surface reaches the same gateway; channel senders must pass the owner lock first.

g.data-tip: Hooks can auto-reply, transform, inject or block; the message is then routed to a session keyed by its origin (thread, slot, cron, subagent, task step).

g.title: 3. Hooks can auto-reply, transform, inject or block; the message is then routed to a session keyed by its origin (thread, slot, cron, subagent, task step).

g.data-tip: Context assembly adds memory, skills, lessons, recent history and cross-session awareness within a token budget.

g.title: 4. Context assembly adds memory, skills, lessons, recent history and cross-session awareness within a token budget.

g.data-tip: The session hands the enriched prompt to its ACP connection (warm or cold harness process).

g.title: 5. The session hands the enriched prompt to its ACP connection (warm or cold harness process).

g.data-tip: JSON-RPC 2.0 over stdio to kiro-cli acp; the harness owns the LLM connection, tools, MCP and compaction.

g.title: 6. JSON-RPC 2.0 over stdio to kiro-cli acp; the harness owns the LLM connection, tools, MCP and compaction.

g.data-tip: The harness streams tokens and tool calls from the model through its own authenticated connection.

g.title: 7. The harness streams tokens and tool calls from the model through its own authenticated connection.

g.data-tip: Before running a tool the harness asks permission over ACP; the ACP client consults Kiro Crew's own PreToolUse gate (deny rules, sensitive paths, governance ceiling POLICY ∩ PROFILE from trust-root files) and answers allow or deny. Decisions go to the hash-chained security event log.

g.title: 8. Before running a tool the harness asks permission over ACP; the ACP client consults Kiro Crew's own PreToolUse gate (deny rules, sensitive paths, governance ceiling POLICY ∩ PROFILE from trust-root files) and answers allow or deny. Decisions go to the hash-chained security event log.

g.data-tip: Allowed tools run inside the OS sandbox (Linux namespaces or macOS Seatbelt); output is redacted before it leaves.

g.title: 9. Allowed tools run inside the OS sandbox (Linux namespaces or macOS Seatbelt); output is redacted before it leaves.

g.data-tip: MCP tools go through Kiro Crew's pooled MCP gateway daemon, a separate process shared across sessions.

g.title: 10. MCP tools go through Kiro Crew's pooled MCP gateway daemon, a separate process shared across sessions.
